name: GAIL (India) Ltd.
business_summary: India's largest gas midstream PSU: owns/operates >11,500 km natural-gas pipelines (roughly 50% of national transmission, model knowledge), gas marketing (domestic + long-term LNG contracts incl. US cargoes), LPG recovery (6 units, ~2,300 km LPG pipeline), a 810 ktpa polyethylene petrochemical plant at Pata, and stakes in Petronet LNG (12.5%), city-gas distributors and OPaL. Government of India owns ~51.9% (promoter) plus ~7.6% via other government holders. Earnings are driven by marketing margins, transmission volumes x PNGRB tariffs, LPG/liquid prices and petchem spreads. Q2 FY27 PAT Rs ~4.7k cr, more than double a year earlier.

revenue_mix.geography: India (imported LNG + domestic gas); share is model knowledge, FY25 approximation

revenue_mix.segment: other (city gas stakes, E&P, power, trading)

exposures.mechanism: Gas/LNG +15%. GAIL buys ~ all gas (gas purchase ~85% of costs, model knowledge) and sells through marketing at pass-through formulas, so unit margin is only partly hit, but spot-LNG-priced volumes are cut by demand destruction (fertiliser, CGD industrial, power) and transmission throughput falls. GAIL's US Henry-Hub-linked LNG (Cheniere/Cove Point, model knowledge) gains relative to spot, partly offsetting. Rough arithmetic: transmission+marketing EBITDA ~Rs 18k cr normalised; 2% volume loss on transmission (~Rs 6k cr EBITDA at 70% margin) and ~5% lower marketing volumes => ~-4% EBITDA x EV/MCap 1.05 x persistence 0.3 => ~-1.3 to -1.6. Pack elasticity -0.22 (t -0.7, series is Henry Hub not LNG) is directionally consistent but insignificant.

evidence.note: Hormuz closure lifted Asian spot LNG; India gas demand fell (OilPrice 14 Oct, Reuters 2 Oct)
GAIL Gas moves to blended pricing as LNG rates rise (ET 12 Sep)

exposures.mechanism: Brent +10%: LPG/liquid-hydrocarbon (LPG ~1.2 MMT/yr, model knowledge) and polymer realisations rise with crude; oil-indexed LNG cost lags 3-6 months; liquid-fuel substitution widens gas marketing margins (Q1-Q2 FY27 profit jump coincided with Brent >$100: Q1 PAT 4,671, Q2 4,724 vs 1,481 in Mar-26 quarter). LPG+LH EBIT ~Rs 2.5k cr: +10% price ~ +Rs 800 cr (4.4% of 18k EBITDA) x 1.05 x persistence 0.3 => +1.4, minus oil-linked gas cost drag => +1.2. Pack shows no Brent link in top-12 (insignificant); low confidence.

evidence.note: Q2 FY27: PAT ~Rs4,650-4,724 cr, revenue +17-33% y/y; GAIL Gas IPO approved (ET, Moneycontrol, BS)

exposures.mechanism: INR 3% weaker raises rupee cost of USD-priced LNG (>50% of gas portfolio imported) before sales prices adjust; LPG/petchem are USD-parity priced so partially offset; USD debt is small. Net ~-3.5% EBITDA hit x 1.05 x persistence 0.3 => ~-1.1. Pack elasticity -1.78 (t -1.5) agrees on sign.

Debt Rs ~16k cr (interest Rs 323 cr/qtr) so funding-cost effect on earnings is negligible (<0.5% of PBT per 25bp); the effect is through the discount rate on a 3% dividend-yield PSU trading at 9.6x P/E. Duration-style estimate: ~5% value change per 100bp => 1.2% per 25bp x 0.5 (partly priced by growth) => -0.6.

GDP +1pp lifts gas consumption (power, fertiliser, CGD, refineries) by ~1.2pp (elasticity ~1.2) => transmission+marketing volumes +1.2% => EBITDA +1.5-2% (operating leverage on fixed pipeline) x 1.05 x persistence 1.0 (structural volume path) => +1.7; haircut for gas-price-driven volume volatility => +1.5.

Fertiliser plants take ~25-30% of GAIL volumes (model knowledge) at pooled prices; a higher subsidy envelope sustains pooled-gas offtake at high LNG prices and avoids offtake cuts and payment delays. +1 step ~ +2% volume stability on ~25% of volumes => EBITDA +1% x 1.05 x 0.7 => ~+0.8. Also GAIL signed MoU with RCF for a Maharashtra fertiliser project (PSU Watch 30 Oct 2026).

evidence.note: Q2 FY27: PAT ~Rs4,650-4,724 cr, revenue +17-33% y/y; GAIL Gas IPO approved (ET, Moneycontrol, BS)

exposures.mechanism: One step = PNGRB unified-tariff / network-tariff reduction of ~10%. Transmission EBIT ~Rs 5.5k cr (~30% of EBITDA, model knowledge FY25); 10% tariff cut => -Rs 600 cr = -3.3% EBITDA x EV/MCap 1.05 x persistence 0.8 (structural) => -2.8, round to -3.0. PNGRB tariff reviews are periodic and discretionary; timing unknown.

Escalation (Hormuz) cuts Qatari LNG supply to India (Petronet, where GAIL holds 12.5%, model knowledge) and spikes spot LNG; GAIL's US term cargoes and Brent-linked LPG gains cushion margins but throughput and Petronet-associated earnings fall. Share rose +5.6% in 3m through the conflict, so the realised net effect has been mixed; central -1.5 with wide range.

evidence.note: Hormuz closure lifted Asian spot LNG; India gas demand fell (OilPrice 14 Oct, Reuters 2 Oct)

exposures.mechanism: Pata plant 810 ktpa PE (+ expansion pipeline, model knowledge). +10% polymer-naphtha spread ~ +$55/t x 0.65 Mt = ~$36m ~ Rs 340 cr (1.9% of Rs 18k cr EBITDA) x 1.05 x persistence 0.4 => +0.8; add operating gearing => +1.1.

Gas-fired power is <10% of GAIL volumes but is the swing buyer when RLNG is affordable; +3pp power demand growth adds marginal offtake only in lower-price states. ~+0.4% EBITDA x 1.05 x persistence 0.5 ~ +0.3-0.5.
